title: UHC Essentials
description: Optimzation and Utility for UHC, Mazer and Hoplite!
body:
## **UHC Essentials**

Looking to trap players in Hoplite or UHC servers? This pack is built for you!

The UHC Essentials modpack combines mods and resource packs that are perfect for Ultra Hardcore gameplay, especially on servers like mazerclub.net or hoplite.gg.

**✨Features**


**Waypoints** – Mark traps or important locations with ease.

**Large UHC Dropped Items** – Golden apples, golden heads, and other key drops appear larger on the ground. Fully customizable in the config.

**Optimization Mods** – Includes Sodium, Lithium, and more for smoother performance.

**Zoomify** – Zoom in to spot players or traps from afar.

**Coordinates Display** – Always know your exact position.

**Minimap & Full-Screen Map** – Navigate servers with a clear overview of the terrain.

**Custom Resource Packs** – Enhances visuals for UHC gameplay.

**🎮Keybinds**

**Set Waypoint (hold):** B

**Zoom:** C

**Toggle** Minimap: Z

(All keybinds can be customized to your preference.)

**🏆Why Use It?**

Whether you’re optimizing performance, tracking coordinates, or setting up traps, this pack gives you the **Essential tools for competitive UHC**. The streamlined keybinds ensure everything is within reach, so you can focus on strategy and gameplay.

Enjoy the pack and happy trapping!
